summary: Phase 4 testing complete. Backend: 54/54 pytest PASS (40 prior + 14 new Phase 4 cases). Frontend: All new Phase 4 panels working: AI Portfolio Monitor (100/100 health, alerts list, manual refresh button), WhatsApp Alerts panel (SETUP NEEDED status, instructions, phone save input), TradingView candlestick chart on /stock/RELIANCE with volume bars + 1D/1W/1M period switcher, technical indicators (RSI/MACD/Volume Ratio) and market data (Market Cap/PE/Day Range/52W). New endpoints: /api/monitor/health, /api/monitor/run, /api/monitor/alerts, /api/whatsapp/status, /api/whatsapp/test, /api/whatsapp/configure, /api/zerodha/urls, /api/zerodha/callback (302 redirect to /settings?zerodha=cancelled), /api/zerodha/postback. /api/data-sources now includes whatsapp block with mode=simulated. WhatsApp send returns success+source=simulated (MOCKED – no Twilio keys).

minor.issue: On cancelled/failed it redirects to '/settings?...' (relative) because CORS_ORIGINS may not be a full URL. The route should use REACT_APP frontend URL env var; current fallback works but produces relative redirects.
No HMAC signature verification on incoming postback — anyone with the URL can inject fake order events into zerodha_postbacks collection.
Carry-over: still accepts unauthenticated user_id via query string.

integration_issues.issue: Console still shows 'WebSocket is closed before the connection is established' on first dashboard load. Carry-over from iteration 3, non-blocking.

issues: TradingView lightweight-charts v5 renders cleanly with candlesticks + volume bars + price scale. Period switcher (1D/1W/1M) works. Layout responsive.
Portfolio Monitor + WhatsApp panels added below FII/DII row look clean in both themes. Health-score green bar at 100/100 in current seed-data state.

action_items: (Security) Add HMAC signature verification to /api/zerodha/postback before persisting to DB.
(Optional polish) /api/zerodha/callback should redirect to frontend URL from env (not CORS_ORIGINS first entry) so success/fail UI is consistent across deployments.
(Carry-over) Authenticate WebSocket handshake with JWT and silence reconnect-on-route-change warning in useWebSocket hook.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1260 lines — split monitor, whatsapp, zerodha routers into their own files for maintainability.
portfolio_monitor.analyze_portfolio_health accepts market_func but never uses it — remove the unused parameter or wire it into a market-context bullish/bearish factor.

/api/whatsapp/test does not respect the per-user 'whatsapp_number' saved via /configure — it just sends from TWILIO_WHATSAPP_FROM to USER_WHATSAPP_TO (single global recipient). In live mode this means every user's test message goes to the same admin phone.
TradingChart.jsx mounts with hard-coded width from container.clientWidth — verify ResizeObserver is attached so it re-renders on sidebar collapse / window resize.
Zerodha postback writes raw body to DB without schema validation — add Pydantic model to filter junk fields.

All Phase 4 features (portfolio monitor health + alerts, WhatsApp simulated send/configure, Zerodha URLs/callback/postback, TradingView candlestick chart, dashboard panels) function as specified. Only carry-over minor issues remain (WebSocket auth, postback signature, WS reconnect console noise).
